title: Blood & Truth
subtitle: An action film within arm’s reach
summary: Blood & Truth is London Studio's cinematic virtual-reality shooter, released for PlayStation VR on 28 May 2019.
body: Blood & Truth is London Studio's cinematic virtual-reality shooter, released for PlayStation VR on 28 May 2019. Former soldier Ryan Marks returns to London and becomes caught in a violent struggle involving his family and a crime boss. The story unfolds through dramatic scenes and playable confrontations, placing the player inside the role of an action-film protagonist. Guns, nearby objects and cover become things to handle from that viewpoint, connecting the spectacle of the sequence to actions performed within the player's immediate space.

Moving through a firefight uses designated positions: the player looks towards a location and selects it, and Ryan travels there. That structure gives the encounter a directed flow while leaving attention available for aiming, interacting and reacting to opponents. Cover separates one position from another, and different guns change how the next group can be approached. Small object interactions extend the physical relationship beyond firing a weapon, allowing quieter moments in the surroundings to support the feeling of inhabiting Ryan's part in the story.

An interrogation frames the narrative, with Ryan's recollections carrying the player through the events leading to it. London Studio developed the production from its experience creating virtual-reality action, and Jim Fowler and Joe Thwaites composed the score. The result combines performed storytelling with short, legible physical tasks. Its movement system supports carefully arranged action scenes while the headset makes their scale and proximity tangible. Blood & Truth develops the idea of a playable action film around the player's hands, gaze and position inside each encounter.
